construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

input.schema: 1..100 field objects; required name, type, required; optional aliases
input.labels: Field name and up to 20 aliases; case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized, globally unique

output.status: ok for completed extraction, even with unresolved fields; error for input/file failures
output.fields: Schema-ordered objects: name, type, required, state, value, sources, message
output.sources: Objects with label, text, start and end; zero-based, half-open Unicode code-point offsets into the original document
output.missing_fields: Required fields without an extracted value, with name and reason
output.error: Error output contains status and error message

shared_schema.validation: One Validator layer validates requests and verifies output types, source spans and required-field reporting. JSON duplicate keys and nonstandard constants are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated request -> deterministic labeled-line matcher -> typed conversion -> validated shared result

behavior.matching: One label:value or label=value per line; first delimiter separates label and value; unknown lines ignored
behavior.values: Outer whitespace trimmed; inner text preserved; integers capped at 100 characters; finite decimal numbers; true/false booleans; strict valid YYYY-MM-DD dates
behavior.ambiguity: Any repeated matching label, including aliases or identical values, is ambiguous; all candidate spans retained
behavior.missing: Absent and blank values are missing. Required missing, invalid and ambiguous fields appear in missing_fields; optional unresolved fields remain visible in fields.
behavior.cli: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON input file argument. Prints one JSON object; exit 0 on completed extraction, exit 2 on validation/file errors.
behavior.fixtures: Example and tests use clearly labeled synthetic data; no live documents or services

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exit 0, one valid JSON object with status ok, six extracted fields and required purchase_order reported missing
test_outcomes.cli_errors: Verified exit 2 and JSON status error for missing argument, missing file, invalid JSON, duplicate keys, nonstandard constants and invalid schema
